privacy.statement: All processing happens locally in your browser — your JSON is never sent to a server. Manual installation does not change the extension's permissions or data handling.

faq.question: What does this extension do?
faq.answer: It renders raw JSON pages as a read-only tree view, so you can inspect structure without pasting data into a separate tool.

faq.question: Is my JSON uploaded anywhere?
faq.answer: No. Processing happens locally in your browser, and there is no account or upload step.

faq.question: Why would I install manually instead of using the Chrome Web Store?
faq.answer: Manual installation is for developers, users who want to review the source, and anyone on a network where the Web Store is unavailable. The Web Store is the simpler option for most people because it updates automatically.

faq.question: Will a manually installed extension update automatically?
faq.answer: No. Unpacked extensions do not receive automatic updates. You need to download the new version and reload it in chrome://extensions.

faq.question: How do I verify the downloaded file?
faq.answer: Download SHA256SUMS.txt, run shasum -a 256 on the .zip, and compare the result with the SHA-256 shown on this page.

faq.question: Which browsers are supported?
faq.answer: See the supported browsers listed in the details above. The extension targets Chromium-based browsers using Manifest V3.

github.text: The extension is open source. Review the code, build it yourself, or report a problem.

faq.question: 这个插件是做什么的？
faq.answer: 它把原始 JSON 页面渲染成只读树形视图，你可以直接查看结构，不用把数据粘贴到别的工具。

faq.question: 我的 JSON 会被上传吗？
faq.answer: 不会。处理全部在浏览器本地完成，没有账号，也没有上传步骤。

faq.question: 为什么要手动安装，而不是用 Chrome 商店？
faq.answer: 手动安装面向开发者、想审查源码的用户，以及无法访问商店的网络环境。对大多数人来说，商店安装更简单，因为会自动更新。

faq.question: 手动安装的扩展会自动更新吗？
faq.answer: 不会。已解压的扩展收不到自动更新，你需要下载新版本并在 chrome://extensions 里重新加载。

faq.question: 怎么校验下载的文件？
faq.answer: 下载 SHA256SUMS.txt，对 .zip 运行 shasum -a 256，把结果和本页显示的 SHA-256 值对比。

faq.question: 支持哪些浏览器？
faq.answer: 见上方信息栏列出的支持浏览器。本插件基于 Manifest V3，面向 Chromium 系浏览器。
